[[Sand Wurm]]s are colossal predators that infest some parts of the [[Crystal Desert]].  They lie in wait beneath the surface of the sand, striking at passing travelers with devastating melee attacks.  An attack by a Sand Wurm is always preceded by sudden vibrations in the ground. They are heavy armored foes with a large amount of health and a constant +3 [[health regeneration]].

==Notes==
*The combination of Natural Resistance, high armor, and a lack of active [[skill]]s makes [[Wastrel's Worry]] very effective against them, as the Sand Wurms have no means of ending the [[hex spell]] early.
*They are hostile against all other Crystal Desert wildlife.
